# Lowpoly Cat + Run Animation

## Derivative dated 2026-09-22

The active game uses `assets/models/glb/godot_mvp/cat_refined.fbx`, derived from
this original by rounding/rebuilding the skin, adding articulated paw volumes,
toes, pads, facial details and short coat fibres. Colors follow the project's
selected B reference. A separate four-beat walk was baked in Blender; Godot adds
idle/scratch poses and blends. The 34-bone rig and attribution are retained.
The untouched source FBX below remains available. Rebuild script and editable
source: `assets/models/blender/refine_daily_cat.py` and `cat_refined.blend`.

Downloaded from [itch.io](https://dailylowpoly.itch.io/lowpoly-cat-running) on 2026-09-11.

- Author: Daily Lowpoly (`dailyfree3d`)
- Original title: Lowpoly Cat + Run Animation
- Source file: `cat_rigged.fbx`

The creator states that the model may be used in commercial projects. The asset must remain attributed in distributed project credits. On 2026-09-14 the user selected this model to replace B3 in the active game after the Godot import and visual checks. The project applies the accepted B3 color palette with `cats/cat_reference_color.gdshader`, without modifying the original mesh or rig.
